name: qsv
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow Tier A behavior: qsv configures self_update with an Ed25519 zipsign key included from source; the explicit update flags invoke that verifier-backed path while background checks are notify-only.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact signing or deployment state beyond the checked-in key/configuration.
The final verifier implementation is delegated to Sparkle, tauri-plugin-updater, or self_update where applicable.
